name: project-chat-label
goal: Read-only or unbound project views expose project chat without promising agent execution

evidence: The launch control says Work with agent on pinned and otherwise read-only local projects even though the existing store denies agent work there.

Tighten the existing component capability matrix: each blocked state requires Open project chat, while writable entities retain Work with agent. Existing pinned and hosted browser acceptance also rejects an AI launcher.
